info.description:
Amazon Web Services IoT FleetWise is a fully managed service that you can use to collect, model, and transfer vehicle data to the Amazon Web Services cloud at scale. With Amazon Web Services IoT FleetWise, you can standardize all of your vehicle data models, independent of the in-vehicle communication architecture, and define data collection rules to transfer only high-value data to the cloud.

For more information, see What is Amazon Web Services IoT FleetWise? in the Amazon Web Services IoT FleetWise Developer Guide.

Contact Support: Name: Mike Ralphson Email: mike.ralphson@gmail.com

item.name: Amazon IoT FleetWise List Model Manifest Nodes

request.description:
Lists information about nodes specified in a vehicle model (model manifest).

This API operation uses pagination. Specify the nextToken parameter in the request to return more results.
